title: 第3章 亿万倍暴击返还仙骨第4章 顾清秋傻眼不是我打开的方式不对
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
话音一落，整个议事殿瞬间寂静下来，每一名族老脸上都露出不可思议的神色。
一些族老忍不住劝说顾长歌。
“长歌，你可知至尊骨有多尊贵？”
“对啊，至尊骨可是天生至尊，凭借一根至尊骨便可同阶无敌，更甚至逆伐境界高于自已的天骄，妖孽。”
至尊骨！
顾长歌当然知道。
倒不如说三千道域无人不知至尊骨的强大。
就是因为知道，所以顾长歌才更加不想要啊。
这一看就是buff拉满的东西，况且他本身已经身具重瞳，外加上无敌返还系统，没必要为了一根至尊骨做这种事情。
“长歌知晓。”
顾长歌点头。
“那你！”
一名族老忍不住道。
但他刚刚开口，顾长歌便直接将他的话堵住了，更甚至说出来的话震惊全场。
“重瞳本是无敌路，何须再借他人骨！”
“更何况是妹骨！”
顾长歌背负双手，身姿挺拔，语气自信淡然。
话语间，一股无敌气质从他身上散发。
一众族老心中震动，耳边轰鸣，有人面带欣赏，有人面带惋惜。
“好好好，不愧是我长生顾家第一序列，重瞳本是无敌路，何须再借他人骨！”

顾青哈哈大笑，起身道：“有这等气度，纵使长歌无任何天资，日后也必定可以名动中天道域，现在有我长生顾家相助，响彻三千道域更不在话下。”
众族老见状，只能无奈叹了口气。
他们这么做也是为了主脉好。
毕竟如果真的出现一个重瞳外加上至尊骨的妖孽，单单这个名气便已经名动三千道域，更遑论顾长歌有这等天资，心性了。
顾青说完之后，目光看向顾长歌无比满意说：“既然长歌你已经做了决定，那我们便去见见清秋吧，不夺清秋至尊骨，未来她必定是我长生顾家顶梁柱之一，有些事情也得提前和清秋说明，她还小，但我等也不能对自已所做的事情隐瞒，任何矛盾都得在最小的情况下解决。”
顾长歌闻言点头。
单论处事方法，顾青就已经当得长生顾家家主了。
更遑论他还是一尊王者境九层，接近准圣的至强存在。
……
众人移步封禁顾清秋所在偏房。
躺在床榻上的顾清秋，当感知到禁制消散，门外响起脚步声的时候，心里顿时紧张起来。
“来了吗？”
“长生顾家果然和记忆中一样，迫不及待便来挖自已的至尊骨了。”
“呵呵。”
content_en:
As soon as the words fell, the entire meeting hall fell silent instantly, and every clan elder had an incredible look on his face.
Some clan elders couldn't help but persuade Gu Changge.
"Chang Ge, do you know how noble the Supreme Bone is?"
"Yes, the Supreme Bone is a born supreme. With just one Supreme Bone, one can be invincible at the same level, and can even defeat geniuses and monsters whose realm is higher than one's own."
Supreme Bone!
Of course Gu Changge knew.
It would be better to say that no one in the Three Thousand Dao Realm knows the power of the Supreme Bone.
Just because he knew it, Gu Changge didn't want it even more.
This seems to be something that is full of buffs. Moreover, he already has double pupils, and with the invincible return system, there is no need to do such a thing for a supreme bone.
"Chang Ge knows."
Gu Changge nodded.
"Then you!"
A clan elder couldn't help but said.
But as soon as he opened his mouth, Gu Changge blocked his words, and what he said even shocked the whole audience.
"Double pupils are the way to be invincible, so why borrow another person's bones!"
"Not to mention the younger sister!"
Gu Changge had his hands behind his back, his posture was upright, and his tone was confident and indifferent.
As he spoke, an invincible aura emanated from him.
The hearts of the clan elders were shocked, and their ears were ringing. Some looked appreciative, while others looked regretful.
"Okay, okay, you are worthy of being the first in line of my Immortal Gu family. Double pupils are the way to invincibility, so why borrow another person's bones!"
Gu Qing laughed loudly, stood up and said: "With such magnanimity, even if Changge has no talent, he will definitely be able to make a name for himself in the Zhongtian Dao Domain in the future. Now with the help of my Changsheng Gu family, it will be no problem to resound throughout the Three Thousand Dao Domains."
Seeing this, all the clan elders could only sigh helplessly.
They also do this for the good of the main line.
After all, if a monster with double pupils and supreme bones really appeared, his reputation alone would already be famous in three thousand realms, not to mention Gu Changge's talent and character.
After Gu Qing finished speaking, he looked at Gu Changge with great satisfaction and said: "Since you have made your decision, Changge, let's go see Qingqiu. If we don't take away Qingqiu's supreme bone, she will definitely be one of the pillars of my immortal Gu family in the future. Some things must be explained to Qingqiu in advance. She is still young, but we cannot hide what we have done. Any conflicts must be resolved in the smallest possible way."
Gu Changge nodded when he heard this.
Just in terms of how he handles things, Gu Qing is already the head of the Changsheng Gu family.
Not to mention that he is still a powerful being who is at the ninth level of the King Realm and is close to a quasi-sage.
…
Everyone moved to seal off the side room where Gu Qingqiu was.
Gu Qingqiu, who was lying on the bed, suddenly became nervous when he felt the restriction dissipate and footsteps could be heard outside the door.
"Are you coming?"
"The Changsheng Gu family is indeed the same as in the memory. They can't wait to dig out their own supreme bones."
"Haha."
